definitions.explanation: A hollow cylindrical object for conveying fluids or gases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{管|くだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まった→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
{管|くだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: Water is flowing through the pipe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{排水|はいすい}{管|かん}→排水管：23157_haisuikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れて→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れている→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧。
examples.english: The drainage pipe is broken and water is leaking.
examples.notes: [Note: 管 reads かん in compounds]

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水道|すいどう}{管|かん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びて→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}き→開く：00689_aku⟧、⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れていた→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧。
examples.english: The water pipes in the old house had rusted and developed holes, causing water to leak.

notes:
{管|くだ} refers to any hollow cylindrical object used to convey liquids, gases, or other substances.

PRONUNCIATION:
- くだ: native reading, used when standalone or in some wago compounds
- かん: on'yomi reading, used in most sino-Japanese compounds

COMMON COMPOUNDS (read as かん):
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}{管|かん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧: water pipe
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}{管|かん}→排水管：23157_haisuikan⟧: drainage pipe
- ⟦{血|けっ}{管|かん}→血管：02742_kekkan⟧: blood vessel
- ⟦{気|き}{管|かん}→気管：21172_kikan⟧: trachea, windpipe
- ⟦{管|かん}{理|り}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: management (different meaning — uses same kanji)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {管|くだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to grumble drunkenly, to ramble on while drunk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧: pipe (loanword, often for smoking pipes or industrial pipes)
- ⟦チューブ→チューブ：11586_chuubu⟧: tube (loanword, for flexible tubes)
- ⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧: hose (loanword, for flexible water hoses)
